info.title: IDEA Gateway — existing binary transfer contract
info.description: Dedicated HTTPS data plane. Signed Grant, not Server session; no Server product route inferred.

servers.description: Gateway origin is separately configured, not Server origin

post.description: HTTPS required. Binary response: big-endian int64 verifiedBytes + int32 receiptLength + exactly receiptLength signed Receipt bytes. Not JSON. Negative bodies are empty.

parameters.name: X-IDEA-Range-Start
parameters.description: Inclusive byte offset; must fit long

408.description: Absolute request or inactivity timeout; empty body

503.description: I/O/storage failure; no transfer success inferred

x-idea-contract.authority: HTTPS + exact signed Grant; no ordinary Server session, CSRF or product RBAC here.
x-idea-contract.state: Declared range/chunk hash and exact Grant/Vault/allocation; validated bytes, not custody publication.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Filesystem completion is not PostgreSQL custody. Server Receipt verification + current IAM/allocation commit remain a separate owner operation.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Adapter serializes compatible ranges; conflicting/busy input refuses; no hidden overwrite.
x-idea-contract.retry: Identical range retry/status resolution uses qualified transfer identity; interruption/lost response do not imply custody success. Expired Grant requires explicit Server renewal.
